episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with a Hype Train derailment into hell politics before Case Blackwell live-generated AI Epstein jail footage while troubleshooting broken chat commands. The news desk covered the UN-documented Gaza starvation campaign and US contractor complicity, then pivoted to CNN's newly published Trump-Epstein wedding photos and the exhausted Russia gate revival. Big Cheddar hosted Amongst the Web with audience stories including Japanese claw machine firearms, salmon sperm skincare, AI psychosis, and a 50-year KFC veteran's death. Jeb Nogget taught auctioneering, pelvic resistance rings, and chi bending while Kendelle called in from a Hamptons DJ speakeasy. The broadcast closed with Hate Sock's uncooperative Epstein list confirmation — Munch, Crum, and Kevin listed; Fiona cleared — before raiding Gina.
